scope: Implemented local Codex CLI streaming integration, notification UI, and explicit Konsole window/tab return; global Codex configuration unchanged.

isolation.network: Bubblewrap network namespace; only local mock HTTP inference fixture.
isolation.filesystem: Read-only root; home, temporary storage and workspace redirected to owned temporary paths without changing HOME or CODEX_HOME.
isolation.terminal: Owned pseudoterminal; no input injected into existing terminals or GUI windows.

passed.case: Two subscribed clients receive assistant text, task name updates, user-input request and resolution.
Observer ignores the input request; owner answers successfully.
Observer disconnects during a pending question; owner request stays pending and can be answered.
Real CLI connected through a transparent Unix WebSocket relay renders a choice, submits A, receives resolution and displays original assistant text.
Real CLI receives send_message_to_user_async as agentMessage delivery=async; this fixture has questions=null and phase=final_answer.
Two threads hold simultaneous Plan questions; answering A leaves B pending; answering B resolves B.
Observer joins after questions are issued and receives pending-request replay for both threads.

Production launcher and actual codex-cli 0.160.0 through transparent relay: Default choice captured with isBlocking=false, native owner answered A, resolution captured, full original captured, completed turn captured.
Production relay captures original asynchronous text independently of turn completion.
Native CLI automatic task naming captured as thread/name/updated; temporary thread_title helper and prefetched history excluded; only one root task emitted.
Two owned independent native Konsole windows and two tabs: explicit return selects the exact tab and window; actual KWin activation and Konsole currentSession confirmed.
Interactive circular bubble with owned peek window: stable native ID and geometry, zero extra target repaints, desktop focus unchanged.
Existing native KWin move/maximize/unmaximize/minimize/restore still succeeds on an owned child window.

Nine notice/protocol state tests and six presentation tests passed; long Unicode original through HTTP v2, reader pinning/unread, pending lifecycle, quiet thinking, visibility levels, explicit return order.
Existing nine bridge integration tests and four shell integration tests passed; scoped architecture checks passed; changed Python files pass Ruff.

Native circular bounding shape with no rectangular corners; initial clicks reach the owned background; continuous three-second hover unlocks clicks; exit restores pass-through; native ID, geometry and focus unchanged.
Three speech tests and seven task-presentation tests pass, including opacity persistence/live settings, circle/dot mask, continuous dwell and interrupted hover.

Breeze reproducer: Qt NoDropShadowWindowHint alone leaves _KDE_NET_WM_SHADOW on a tooltip; pre-polish _KDE_NET_WM_SKIP_SHADOW prevents theme shadow on both daily and Codex bubbles, including after hover and opacity changes.

observations: Native CLI starts a temporary ephemeral thread_title helper for automatic naming; capture the root name update and exclude helper messages.
phase=final_answer also occurs on asynchronous agentMessage; celebrate only completed turn status.
isBlocking is authoritative; do not infer blocking from the wording or conversation mode.
Only serverRequest/resolved clears pending input. Viewing pauses repeats; completion, interruption and disconnection preserve unresolved markers.
Konsole currentSession can be stale while inactive; return requires KWin activation followed by currentSession confirmation.
Native Wayland Konsole WINDOWID is not a KWin UUID; locate its MainWindow through winId, then associate using PID and active-window observations.
The two experimental features were disabled in the installed CLI feature listing; the launcher enables them only for its private backend, honoring explicit command-line overrides.
app-server proxy did not initialize against a custom Unix listener; the native remote CLI WebSocket transport was verified instead.

A circular XShape bounding mask does not remove KDE theme shadow tiles. The originally observed live Mori tooltip had _KDE_NET_WM_SHADOW with rectangular margins despite its circular mask and Qt no-shadow hint. Fix sets Breeze shadow opt-out before polishing/window creation.
probeSource: probe.py (research fixture); production_probe.py (isolated production launcher fixture, uses the documented temporary Bubblewrap mounts)
implementedTopology: Owned private app-server <-> byte-preserving Unix WebSocket tee <-> original native remote TUI. Tee decodes copies on an independent queue and delivers provider-neutral schema-v2 notices to local Mori. No extra observer client, request responses, protocol modifications or remote model calls from Mori.
limitations: Tested CLI version 0.160.0; experimental protocol may change.
Full text capture applies to a newly launched or resumed session through mori-codex / the installed interactive codex function; existing running Codex sessions cannot be retroactively connected.
Exact window/tab tracking and explicit return verified on KDE Plasma 6 + Konsole + qdbus6; other terminals use conservative reminders without exact tab return.
Moving a Konsole tab into a new window requires reconnecting the monitored launcher; stale bindings fail conservatively.

Explicit profiles, OSS/local-provider launches, batch/maintenance commands, non-Unix platforms and unavailable live interface use scoped basic hooks; they do not capture originals or precise request lifecycle.
Original messages are in-memory only. Restarting Mori loses delivered history; undelivered IPC notices retry while the monitored CLI is running.
Per-message capture limit is 2 Mi Unicode characters; v2 IPC limit is 12 MiB, existing v1 limit remains 64 KiB.
localVerificationPolicy: Only minimal relevant local checks at each stage; real CLI tests use an isolated local mock model; desktop checks operate only owned temporary windows/tabs.
